question: In 1995, with whom did Eric Cornell experimentally produce the first Bose-Einstein condensate in a rarefied gas of rubidium atoms at extremely low temperatures?
solution:
The correct answer is__ Carl Wieman.__

__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• **Eric Cornell experimentally produced the first Bose-Einstein condensate in a rarefied gas of rubidium atoms at extremely low temperatures in 1995 with Carl Wieman.**
 
• ** Bose-Einstein condensate **is a state of matter that occurs at very low temperatures,** close to absolute zero.**
 
• **Geoffrey Wilkinson was a Nobel Prize-winning chemist** who made significant contributions to the field of organometallic chemistry.
